errors.emptyWorkbook: No sheets with data found in workbook.

ui.appSubtitle: Parse card CSV/XLSX, auto-categorize, edit categories, import a budget, compare actuals to plan. Data persists in this browser and can be exported as JSON.
ui.dashboardHelp: Upload transactions to populate spend. Upload a budget spreadsheet to set targets per category (totals are summed when multiple rows map to the same category).
ui.dashboardEmpty: No data yet. Import transactions (and optionally a budget).
ui.labelNoBudgetCategory: No budget line for this category
ui.transactionsImportHelp: Supports typical issuer exports (Chase, Amex-style columns). Amount sign is detected automatically; payment/credit rows are excluded from spend where possible.
ui.budgetImportHelp: Provide a CSV or Excel file with a category column and an amount column (headers like "Category" and "Monthly Budget" work). Importing replaces the previous budget snapshot so you can revise plans as income changes.
ui.dataHelp: The app mirrors the future database shape in a single JSON document: categories, merchant rules, purchases (each with categoryId), and budget lines. Browsers cannot silently write to disk; changes persist to localStorage and you can download or upload the same JSON for backups or a future API.
ui.footerHosting: Open source layout for AWS static hosting (S3/CloudFront) or GitHub Pages.
ui.confirmClearPurchases: Remove all imported purchases from this browser?
ui.confirmReset: Reset app to defaults (clears local data)?
ui.msgImportedBudget: Loaded {count} budget lines from {file} (replaced previous budget).
